item.title: Arkansas experts emphasize this flu season is severe
item.description: According to the Arkansas Department of Health’s most recent report, 37 Arkansans had died from the flu this season. UAMS Professor of Internal Medicine and Pediatrics, Dr. Robert Hopkins, explained that this was the second severe flu season in a row.

item.title: Jacksonville North Pulaski School District announces new parental advisory committee, parents voice concerns
item.description: Following months of controversy and parents demanding answers after the arrest of custodian Harold Butchart, the Jacksonville North Pulaski School District announced it would be forming a new committee designed to increase communication and enhance transparency between the district and parents.
